title: Multivariate graph-cut combination of climate models: code and compact results
description: Code, compact numerical results and documentation for the article 'Beyond mean fields: a multivariate graph-cut approach to climate-model combination' (prepared for Earth System Dynamics). The archive regenerates all article figures and tables from included numerical results (scores, mean-bias and distributional fields, density-curve coordinates, label maps and histogram supports), demonstrates the longitude-periodic graph-cut solver, and provides entry points for the full ERA5 and perfect-model experiments. The full experiments require external prepared ERA5/CMIP6 daily data that are not included. The graph-cut solver (schmutzlucas/gcoWrapR, pinned commit) is an external dependency under its own terms and is not included. MIT covers the original code and documentation; ERA5/CMIP6 source data remain under their providers' terms. Known limitations, including that the published ERA5 maps (Figs. 1-2) predate the corrected numerical cohort, are listed in docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md.
